messages:
Sam (PM): Quick sync — finalizing the GA wedge plan. Need owners for SLA doc, pricing backstop, support runbook, monitoring dashboards, and canary rollback triggers. Who can own each?
Priya (Eng): I can own SLA perf targets + alert hooks. Need clarity on tiering (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
Darren (SRE): I'll take runbook + canary rollback triggers. Will sketch playbook for autoscale + failover to cheaper model variant.
Noah (FinOps): I'll own pricing backstop and cost guardrails. Propose a soft cap + alerting before enforced throttles.
Lina (Docs): I'll own the customer-facing SLA page and internal runbook docs. Need the expected alert list and escalation matrix.
Priya (Eng): Proposed targets: hosted gen p99 < 350ms (small models), p99 < 1s (large models). Dedicated: SLA focused on availability (99.9%) and throughput guarantees per reserved pool. Comments?
Darren (SRE): Those latency numbers look aggressive for large models at scale. Can we define SLO buckets by model class and sequence length distribution? e.g., small/short, small/long, large/short, large/long.
Sam (PM): Agree on buckets. For GA we should guarantee only small/short class for hosted by default; others get best-effort with comms.
Noah (FinOps): Pricing backstop idea: for burst autoscale, send automated notif at 70% forecasted monthly spend; at 90% escalate to FinOps for approval. If customer wants unlimited burst, need commercial add-on.
Lina (Docs): Noted. For customer docs: I'll include a short FAQ: "What happens during high burst?" and a matrix: "What we guarantee vs best-effort."
Priya (Eng): Alerts we will emit (draft):
```
infra.llm.latency.p99
infra.llm.error_rate.1m
infra.llm.kvcache.hit_rate
infra.llm.queue.depth
infra.llm.autoscale.activity
```
Darren (SRE): Add: infra.llm.fallbacks.used and infra.llm.model_variant.fallback_count
Sam (PM): Support routing — primary: product-support channel -> Tier 1; Tier 2 oncall: eng-oncall LLM squad; Tier 3: SRE. Lina, include this in runbook.
Lina (Docs): Will do. Question: do we want a pre-written customer email template for expected behavior during GA (latency variance, limited region availability)? I can draft.
Noah (FinOps): Yes, include cost transparency language: estimated token rate, burst exposure, billing contacts. Also need a 'safety hold' clause for exceptional storms.
Priya (Eng): For canary plan: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% across 4 hours if no alerts. Canary auto-abort on: p99 latency spike > 2x baseline OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m. Darren to author exact thresholds.
Darren (SRE): I'll add rollback checklist: pause routing, revert model version, flush caches, scale down, notify stakeholders. I'll link the playbook in the runbook doc.
Sam (PM): OK owners: SLA/perf: Priya. Runbook + rollback: Darren. Docs + customer comms: Lina. Pricing backstop: Noah. Product owner: Sam to coordinate.
Priya (Eng): ETA: I'll put a draft SLA doc by EOD Thursday. Need SRE to validate thresholds.
Darren (SRE): I'll review by Friday morning. Also schedule a short simulated surge test next week to validate autoscale + cost signals.
Noah (FinOps): I'll prepare the cost throttle proposal and a simple quota matrix for different commercial tiers. Review on Friday.
Lina (Docs): I'll draft docs + email template by Monday. Will add placeholders for specific numbers once you lock them.
deploy-bot: FYI — prod canary window reserved 2025-06-15T22:00Z.
Sam (PM): Perfect. Last ask: please drop single-line PRs or links to draft docs in this thread when ready. We'll do a quick sign-off meeting Friday 09:00 PT if drafts are in. :thumbsup:
